_comment: analytics wave, round 2: the languages metric, the 30-day rhythm grid, and ONE OVERWRITE. shareStats.nameTogglePrivacy is retranslated in all 20 because it went FALSE the moment top publications became the default: it still said 'Off by default ... they only go on the card if you turn this on'. Run with --allow-overwrite shareStats.nameTogglePrivacy and NOTHING ELSE; every other key here is new and must still collide-fail if it is not. The new copy keeps the true half (article titles are never included) and states the control plainly, so it stays correct whether or not the toggle is later removed. rhythmWeekdays is a comma-separated list of SEVEN single-character initials, MONDAY FIRST, split at the render site: a Monday-first week keeps the two weekend days adjacent, which is most of what makes the grid readable at a glance. Duplicate initials within a locale are expected and fine (en T/T and S/S, de D/D and S/S) because position carries the meaning, not the letter. daysReadLabel deliberately says READ, never 'opened the app': there is no app-open record, session row or launch counter anywhere in the schema, so 'opened' would be a false claim AND would invite someone to add session tracking to make it true. Never edit the 20 dictionaries by hand.
